name: Seaturtle Sports Turtle Toss Cornhole Bean Bag Toss Game
description: FIRST OF ITS KIND PATENT-PENDING collapsible target board technology. SEATURTLE SPORTS is the only authorized distributor of TURTLE TOSS as the manufacturer.LIGHTWEIGHT EXCEPTIONAL-QUALITY set for maximum portability with the same durability as heavy wooden cornhole boards without the weight.ONE FIRST OF ITS KIND COLLAPSIBLE target board. Turtle Toss is a patent pending bag toss game like you've never experienced, an easy companion for an outing to the park, tailgating, a vacation, or wherever your free time takes you. This premium set also comes with a custom carry bag, detailed with a mesh bottom to filter the sand, dirt or whatever else might get trapped inside. Turtle Toss is the only set you will find designed with this much attention to having fun!
